# Wikipedia

> > Wikipedia is a free, multilingual online encyclopedia created and maintained by a community of volunteer editors, operated by the Wikimedia Foundation.

Founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger, Wikipedia has grown from its origins as Nupedia into the world's largest reference website. The English Wikipedia is the original and largest language edition, featuring millions of articles on topics ranging from history and science to culture and technology.

## Reference and Disambiguation

- [Lists of capital cities - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lists_of_capitals): Index of national and subnational capital city lists
- [British - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British): Disambiguation: UK, Great Britain, British English terminology
- [// - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki///): Double-slash disambiguation: C/C++/Java comment syntax and URI notation
- [Achromatic - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Achromatic): Achromatic disambiguation: optics, color theory, vision disorders
- [ABV (disambiguation) - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ABV_(disambiguation)): ABV acronym: alcohol by volume, Melbourne TV station, and more
- [AKR - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AKR): AKR acronym: Akron airport, auroral radiation, ISO 639-3 code
